categoryDefinition: Destruction immunity strictly scoped to the source card possessing the ability
notes: Card text states "This Spirit/Nexus/Ultimate can't be destroyed" or "During this turn/battle, this Spirit can't be destroyed"

categoryDefinition: Destruction immunity scoped to all friendly Grandwalker Nexuses matching an exact character name
exampleAbilityIds: BS55-003#a1 (Zeus); BS74-064#a2 (Contractor Nuadha); BS75-042#a1 (Contractor Indra); BS76-063#a2 (Contractor Brigit)
notes: Uses structured filter: { side: "self", types: ["Grandwalker Nexus", "Nexus"], name: "<Name>" }

categoryDefinition: Destruction immunity scoped to friendly Spirits or Ultimates possessing designated family tag(s)
notes: Includes single family, multi-family slash combinations, and dual Spirit/Ultimate types

categoryDefinition: Destruction immunity scoped to specific named Spirits or source card plus allied family Nexuses
exampleAbilityIds: CB10-061#a1 ("Arms"-named); CB10-014#a1 (Self + Zonjis/Barlckxs); CB13-008#a1 (Self + Mothership Nexuses)
notes: Uses structured filter with names: [...], includeSelf: true, or family: "Mothership", includeSelf: true

categoryDefinition: Destruction immunity applied to a target chosen during spell/effect resolution
notes: Card text states "Target one of your Cost 6 or less Spirits. During this turn, it can't be destroyed..."

categoryDefinition: Destruction immunity scoped to allied Nexuses and named Spirits with an explicit named card exclusion
notes: Card text states "Besides your exactly-named Sai, Gorilla, Zou Core Medal, all Core Medal Nexuses and Henshin!! Kamen Rider OOO..."
